name: sorted-list
description: SortedList as a sorted multiset of integers: ordering, duplicates, removal of one copy, positional reads and pops with negative positions, and the IndexError/ValueError contract.

actions.create: SortedList(start), then _reset(2) so short histories split and merge sublists and use the positional index
actions.remove: sl.remove(value), observed as Missing when it raises ValueError
actions.popAt: sl.pop(position), observed as Returned(value) or OutOfRange when it raises IndexError
actions.readAt: sl[position], observed as Returned(value) or OutOfRange when it raises IndexError

mutants.name: discard-removes-all
mutants.description: discard() deletes every copy of a duplicated value instead of one

mutants.name: remove-missing-silent
mutants.description: remove() of an absent value returns quietly instead of raising ValueError

mutants.name: stale-index-on-add
mutants.description: add() into a sublist that does not split forgets to update the positional index

mutants.name: stale-index-on-delete
mutants.description: deleting from a sublist that does not merge forgets to update the positional index

limits: Integers 0-3, positions -6 to 6, starting lists of at most 7 values, at most 10 steps per sampled history.
Load factor 2 (set with the documented _reset), not the default 1000; key functions (SortedKeyList), slicing, bisect, irange and update are not modeled.
Single-threaded; the driver's projection list(sl) is trusted.
